evidence.claim: Lite is $0/month with 90% streaming revenue; Core is $2.50/month billed annually; SoundOn emphasizes TikTok and analytics.
Unlimited starts at ¥4,400/year tax included, Pay Per Release single starts at ¥1,551/year, and distribution revenue is 100% after store fees.
Musician is $24.99/year for unlimited uploads and 100% earnings; Musician Plus is $44.99/year and Ultimate is $89.99/year on the cited US pricing page.
CD Baby charges a one-time $9.99 per single or $14.99 per album, with no annual subscription fee, and says artists keep over 90%.
Free distribution costs $0 and pays 85% of net revenue; Premium costs $10 single, $20 EP, $30 album, $45 extended album plus $9.99 annual renewal from year two.
BIG UP! Free pays 70% of streaming receipts and 83% of download receipts; Basic starts at ¥500/year per title for 1–2 tracks and pays 100% of received streaming/download revenue.

LANDR Distribution Basic is $24/year and Pro is $45/year; distribution supports 150+ stores and 100% earnings. If subscription is cancelled, LANDR states a 15% royalty commission applies while releases remain live.
Amuse currently lists Artist at $23.99/year, Artist Plus at $39.99/year and Professional at $59.99/year; Artist includes unlimited releases, daily streaming insights and royalty advances.
Ditto lists Starter at $19/year, Pro at $59/year and Labels at $109/year; plans include unlimited releases and 100% streaming royalties, with 150+ platforms on Starter.
ONErpm says there is no registration/distribution fee and pays 85% for download stores, 70% for YouTube and 50% for videos excluding YouTube; it also provides analytics and promotional tools.

Symphonic Starter is $29.99/year with 100% DSP royalties for one primary artist; Partner is a custom percentage-based deal for established artists and labels. Symphonic supports 200+ service providers.
UnitedMasters DEBUT+ is $19.99/year and SELECT is $59.99/year, both retaining 100% of streaming royalties; DEBUT+ supports unlimited releases to 150+ services and PARTNER is invite-only.

Too Lost describes distribution to 450+ stores, 200+ territories, 100% royalty share, daily analytics, splits, catalog migration and publishing; current public site supports a SaaS-style distribution and catalog workflow.

Record Union lists Top Dog from $14/year and World Domination from $19/year for 1–2 tracks, with 20+ global services on World Domination; Royalty Upgrade can increase take-home streaming/download royalties to 92.5%.
Songtradr lists Starter at $0/year with 90% distribution royalties, Lite at $19/year with 100%, and Pro at $49/year with 100%; its platform combines distribution, licensing and monetization.
